name: feature.slides.nodes
description: Slides canvas node pack: the `render` producer plus the ADR 0328 P6 `slides.design` chain nodes (outline / draft / deepen / notes / audit) and `restyle`. AI nodes run through ctx.callAI (BYOK; provider/model from node config); outline/draft are the paid core, deepen/notes are soft-fail-loud enhancers, audit is deterministic (zero AI). Constrained typed JSON against the closed slide/block catalog, never executable code.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Render slide deck
nodes.description: Emit a `canvas.slides` artifact. Inputs: { title?, theme?, slides: [{ layout, title?, subtitle?, bullets?, attribution?, imageUrl?, notes? }] } (or `deck` as the whole object, or `source` as its JSON). Output: a typed canvas.slides artifact (contentTrust: model-authored structured JSON). Pure transform.

nodes.label: Outline deck
nodes.description: ONE ctx.callAI call turning a `brief` into a deck outline, emitted as a SKELETON canvas.slides artifact (one section slide per planned slide, intent in notes) for the HITL outline gate, plus the outline object for the draft stage. Hard-fails on AI failure (the paid checkpoint).

nodes.label: Draft deck from outline
nodes.description: ONE ctx.callAI call expanding the approved `outline` into a full blocks-based deck against the closed block catalog, re-normalized through the same gate as render. Hard-fails on AI failure (the paid core).

nodes.label: Deepen thin slides
nodes.description: Per-slide regeneration (the ADR 0325 shape): enrich the thinnest blocks slides (config maxSlides<=4, minBlocks threshold), one ctx.callAI per slide, each re-normalized; failures keep the original and surface a loud `warning`.

nodes.label: Generate speaker notes
nodes.description: ONE ctx.callAI call writing speaker notes for slides missing them; the deck passes through unchanged on failure with a loud `warning`.

nodes.label: Audit deck (deterministic)
nodes.description: Zero-AI quality report: empty slides, duplicate titles, bullet/block overload, missing notes, deck-too-small, all-skipped, plus upstream deepen/notes warnings as findings. Outputs { report: { score, findings, summary } } and passes the artifact THROUGH for the review gate.

nodes.label: Restyle deck (content-preserving)
nodes.description: ONE ctx.callAI call returning ONLY style fields (theme + per-slide variant/background/transition) applied onto the input deck — content preservation by construction; the model's content fields are never read.
